import json,pathlib,re
p='products/services/topcoder-implementation/raw/active-challenges-v6.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
items=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('result',d.get('data',d))
if isinstance(items,dict): items=items.get('content',items.get('data',[items]))
out=[]
for c in items:
  pr=[]
  for ps in c.get('prizeSets',[]) or []:
    pr.append({'type':ps.get('type'),'prizes':[(x.get('type'),x.get('value')) for x in ps.get('prizes',[])]})
  desc=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',(c.get('description') or ''))
  out.append({'id':c.get('id'),'name':c.get('name'),'track':c.get('track'),'type':c.get('type'),'status':c.get('status'),'submissionEndDate':c.get('submissionEndDate') or c.get('endDate'),'registrationEndDate':c.get('registrationEndDate'),'numOfRegistrants':c.get('numOfRegistrants'),'numOfSubmissions':c.get('numOfSubmissions'),'prizeSets':pr,'tags':c.get('tags'),'legacy':c.get('legacy'),'terms':c.get('terms'),'task':c.get('task'),'groups':c.get('groups'),'desc_head':desc[:600],'desc_len':len(desc),'has_ai':bool(re.search(r'\b(AI|LLM|ChatGPT|generative|Copilot)\b',desc))})
r={'top_keys':list(d.keys()) if isinstance(d,dict) else 'list','count':len(out),'challenges':out}
pathlib.Path('products/services/topcoder-implementation/active-extract.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=1))
print(json.dumps(r)[:7000])
